question: What denominator and cohort provenance must accompany a GA chatbot QA pass-rate comparison?
production_path: investigation: observe hypothesize test conclude reflect
hypothesis: Displaying counts and category mix alongside pass rates may help a reader detect an unweighted mean or a changed prompt population before attributing a quality improvement.
evidence: GA commit dc2e74cbd992a298f67efb928b5b3754615e1924: state/quality/chatbot-qa/2026-06-15.json reports 52 prompts, 75.0% overall, operations 28.57% of 7, and typo-tolerance 75% of 4.
The same GA commit: state/quality/chatbot-qa/2026-07-19.json reports 52 prompts and 98.08% overall. Neither file gives prompt identities or an evaluator revision.
The teaching counterfactual removes the June operations category: (39 - 2) / (52 - 7) = 37/45, approximately 82.22%; it is not an observed GA run.
